# TH09 reconstruction handoff

## Current phase

Exact reconstruction: the target and native IDA provider are attested, the
provisional function inventory is initialized, and boundary/origin review has advanced through reviewed CRT/library and compiler-generated exclusions plus 80 repository-canonical exact authored functions across the currently reconstructed subsystems. The faithful Windows i386 whole-build graph is still open; runtime
semantic validation and portability work have not started.

- Stable committed TH08 HEAD `a45e99fb1942714e6edded20847e32a654d56f97` supplied the `SetCallback`/`CreateElem` naming and natural source-shape hypothesis.
